name: Corn Stover Collection (Rye Cover Crop Land Management with Energy Allocation)
notes:
In this scenario, a winter rye cover crop is grown after corn harvest and stover collection in a corn-soy rotation. The land management change scenario considers energy allocation of all corn farming, stover collection, and cover crop management inputs, Also defined by this scenario is a 30% stover removal rate, US average tillage, and a yield increase every year over the 30 year corn-soy rotation.
